Healthy.description: The leaf appears healthy according to the AI model.
symptoms: Generally green and healthy-looking appearance
No obvious disease spots
No major discoloration or tissue damage
solutions: Continue appropriate watering
Provide suitable sunlight
Maintain good air circulation
Inspect the plant regularly for changes
prevention: Regularly check leaves for unusual spots or discoloration

Tomato_Early_Blight.description: A fungal disease that commonly affects tomato leaves and can cause dark spots and gradual leaf damage.
symptoms: Dark brown or black spots on older leaves
Spots may develop concentric ring patterns
Yellowing around affected areas
Leaves may dry out and fall as the disease progresses
solutions: Remove severely affected leaves
Dispose of infected plant material away from healthy plants
Avoid watering the leaves from above
Improve air circulation around plants
Follow local agricultural guidance for disease-management products
prevention: Use healthy seeds or planting material

Tomato_Late_Blight.description: A serious plant disease that can spread rapidly, particularly under cool and wet conditions.
symptoms: Irregular dark green or brown patches
Water-soaked appearance may occur
Rapidly spreading leaf damage
Dark lesions may appear on stems or fruit
Affected leaves may become dry and damaged
solutions: Remove severely affected plant material where practical
Keep suspected infected material away from healthy plants
Avoid overhead irrigation
Improve air circulation
Seek advice from a local agricultural expert
Use approved disease-management products only according to their label
prevention: Inspect plants frequently during humid weather

Potato_Early_Blight.description: A fungal disease of potato plants that commonly produces dark spots on leaves.
symptoms: Brown or dark spots on leaves
Ring-like patterns may develop inside spots
Yellowing around affected areas
Older leaves may be affected first
Severely affected leaves may dry and fall
solutions: Remove severely affected plant material where practical
Avoid overhead watering
Improve air circulation
Remove infected plant debris
Follow local agricultural guidance for disease management
prevention: Remove infected plant debris after harvest
